clips.title: The story
paras: Within Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight's Hammer gathers beneath Queen Azshara's statue. Twilight Lord Kelris watches over the ancient shrine, which guards the sealed way to Aku'mai's lair.

Past the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, cultists gather in the Moonshrine Sanctum, the heart of Twilight's Hammer activity inside Blackfathom Deeps. Night elves built the hall millennia ago to honor the moon and their rulers. Now the cult has defiled it, yet carefully maintains the towering statue of Queen Azshara. Beneath the cavernous stone ceiling, Twilight Lord Kelris watches as the cultists chant dark rituals day and night.
